dct_description_sm: Beaver Creek is an experimental road site were mitigation techniques, aiming to control permafrost degradation along the Alaska Highway, are being tested since implementation in summer 2008. The site comprises 12 sub-sections including a control sub-section.  Laboratory soil testing on Beaver Creek samples were conducted in order to characterize the local permafrost conditions.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Roads
dct_title_s: Beaver Creek experimental site soil properties
